title: H-WIGNER-SATO-TATE-CONVERGENCE: Emergence of Wigner Semicircle / GUE Statistics from Artin-Schreier Exponential Sums
author: Antigravity (ExactQuantumNumericsMind v1.0, eqn-mix)

H-WST-1.statement: Second moment m_2 of normalized family t_a = S(x^3+ax)/(2*sqrt(q)) converges to 1/4 = 0.2500

H-WST-2.statement: Fourth moment m_4 converges to 1/8 = 0.1250 (Catalan C_2 / 16)

H-WST-3.statement: Sixth moment m_6 converges to 5/64 = 0.078125 (Catalan C_3 / 64) for q >= 500

H-WST-4.statement: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against Wigner semicircle CDF confirms perfect distributional match with D_KS <= 0.050 and p >= 0.10
H-WST-4.falsification_condition: Any prime q >= 500 with D_KS > 0.080 or p < 0.05

methodology.family: Cubic Artin-Schreier sum S(x^3 + ax) across a in GF(q)
methodology.connection: Direct link between Deligne Weil-I bound and GUE random matrix eigenvalue spacing
